title_or_table: Business Formation Statistics, monthly business applications (series BA_BA), not seasonally adjusted, summed to calendar years
table_id: BFS monthly file, sa=U, naics_sector=TOTAL, series=BA_BA
geography: 50 states and DC, with a United States row (code US)
universe_or_base: Applications for an Employer Identification Number filed with the IRS that indicate a new business, as the Census Bureau classifies them
unit: business applications; change_pct computed and stored to four decimals, so a chart rounds once
vintage: Business Formation Statistics, September 2026 monthly release, posted October 14, 2026 and retrieved November 11, 2026. The October 2026 monthly release of November 12, 2026 applied the Bureau’s annual update and revised 2022 to 2025; this file keeps the September release until the Phase 5 refresh
qualification: An application is a filing for a tax ID, not a business that opens or hires; many applications never become employers. Totals are the studio's sums of the unadjusted monthly figures

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Business Formation Statistics, September 2026 monthly release (October 14, 2026), business applications, 2019 and 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Applications for a tax ID that signal a new business; many never hire; annual totals summed by Oath & Action.
derivation: For each state, DC and the nation, the 2019 and 2025 annual totals from the frozen file, their difference and its percent of 2019
notes: Release confirmed November 12, 2026 from the Bureau’s own pages: the BFS release schedule (https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/release_schedule.html) lists the September 2026 report on Wednesday, October 14, 2026 and the October 2026 report on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and the BFS page (https://www.census.gov/econ/bfs/index.html) reads "The latest annual update was applied during the October 2026 monthly release on November 12, 2026." The file this one was summed from was retrieved November 11, between the two. The November 12 file (last-modified Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:00:14 GMT; SHA-256 prefix 47975a1c7bca0aad), summed the same way, matches this file in every row for 2005 to 2021 and differs for 2022 to 2025: the 2025 United States total is 5,696,742 there against 5,671,836 here, a rise from 2019 of 62.8 percent against 62.1, and Wyoming has 81,688 against 79,023. The frozen figures stay until the Phase 5 refresh (research ledger, Part 7, "Phase 5 refresh list").
